approach: Static recompilation of the SH-4 code to C with its own translator; native runtime with an OpenGL renderer, AICA audio and GGPO rollback
notes: Native Windows build of SoulCalibur (USA). 16:9 widescreen with undistorted HUD and menus, any resolution with anti-aliasing, VSync, smooth upscaled text, a virtual memory card, and Online Versus in the main menu: worldwide lobby, NAT hole punching with a relay fallback and GGPO rollback. Every main menu mode runs. Contains no game code or data; it needs the player's own copy of the game.
